item.title: Georgia House passes bill prohibiting left-shoulder traffic stops to boost road safety
item.description: Few things make a driver tense up faster than seeing flashing lights in the rearview mirror. Even during a routine traffic stop, that moment of uncertainty can lead to quick, sometimes poor decisions.Instead of safely pulling to the right shoulder, some drivers stop on the left shoulder, creating unnecessary risk for everyone on the road. item.description: Longtime photographer Bud Smith has spent more than six decades capturing the icons of Atlanta, and now he is looking to ensure his massive archive of over one million images finds a permanent home to educate future generations.Smith, who will turn 78 in April, has documented a front-row seat to history from the basement of his East Point home. item.title: Man previously deported now accused of trafficking from Brookhaven apartment
item.description: A man who was previously deported for being in the United States illegally is now accused of trafficking 37 pounds of fentanyl from his Brookhaven apartment, federal prosecutors said. Drug Enforcement Administration agents executed a search at Abelardo Avila Gomez’s apartment on Feb. 16, where they found 15 bricks of fentanyl that weighed about 37 pounds.Avila Gomez was arrested in the apartment parking lot. item.title: DeKalb school board hears from parents on restructuring proposal
item.description: The DeKalb County Board of Education is considering a proposal to close 27 schools, add capacity to 11, and convert eight others. School leaders held a meeting on Monday night to hear from parents about the proposed restructuring. Parents say they want more information on what the restructuring could mean for their children.
